info.title: DubStack Docs Runtime API
info.description: Public runtime endpoints exposed by each published DubStack docs site. These endpoints let readers, API playgrounds, assistants, and MCP-capable clients inspect and query the published documentation for the current site. The surface is scoped to the site that serves it and does not expose dashboard administration APIs.

servers.description: Published docs site origin for this example deployment

tags.name: AI Access
tags.description: Read-only endpoints for agents, crawlers, and MCP-capable clients that need structured access to published documentation.

tags.name: Assistant
tags.description: Reader-facing assistant endpoint for answering questions from the published documentation corpus.

tags.name: API Playground
tags.description: Runtime endpoints used by generated API reference pages and the browser request builder.

get.description: Returns the public Model Context Protocol discovery document for the current docs site. Use this endpoint to confirm that the site exposes a read-only MCP server, discover the supported transport, and find the tools available to agents. The endpoint is tenant-scoped by the request host, so it only describes the published documentation for the current site.

200.description: Discovery metadata for the current site's public read-only MCP server.

value.name: DubStack Docs MCP
value.description: Read-only MCP server for this published documentation site.

post.description: Handles Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC requests for the public docs MCP server. Clients use this endpoint to list tools and call read-only tools such as documentation search or virtual filesystem reads. Tool execution is scoped to published docs content for the current site and should not be used for authoring or dashboard administration.

requestBody.description: Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC request sent by an MCP client.

200.description: JSON-RPC response from the public MCP server. Successful tool calls return method-specific results; invalid requests return JSON-RPC error objects.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the published docs for relevant pages.

tools.name: query_docs_filesystem
tools.description: Read published docs through a read-only virtual filesystem.

delete.description: Closes a Streamable HTTP MCP session when a client no longer needs the connection. Stateless clients may not need to call this endpoint, but session-aware clients can use it to release server-side session state cleanly.

200.description: Session close acknowledgement with a JSON response body.

ok.description: Whether the session close request was accepted.

204.description: Session close acknowledgement without a response body.

get.description: Returns a single server-card document for the current docs site. Discovery clients can use this well-known URL to identify the public MCP endpoint, display name, description, and transport before connecting.

200.description: Server-card metadata for the public MCP endpoint on this docs site.

value.name: DubStack Docs MCP
value.description: Read-only MCP access to the published docs site.

get.description: Returns the collection of MCP server cards advertised by the current docs site. Most sites expose one public read-only docs MCP server, but the collection form lets discovery clients handle multiple advertised servers consistently.

200.description: Collection of MCP server cards advertised by this docs site.

servers.name: DubStack Docs MCP
servers.description: Read-only MCP access to the published docs site.

get.description: Returns the compact LLM-readable index for the current docs site as plain text. This export gives agents a fast overview of important pages, canonical URLs, and high-value entry points without needing to crawl rendered HTML.

200.description: Compact plain-text index of the published docs site for LLM and agent consumption.

schema.description: Plain-text LLM index. The exact content depends on the published site navigation and page metadata.

index.value:

> Product documentation for building, publishing, and operating DubStack docs sites.

## Pages
- [Quickstart](https://dubstack-docs-test.dubstack.live/quickstart)

get.description: Returns the expanded LLM-readable export for the current docs site as plain text. Use this endpoint when an agent needs deeper page summaries and selected body content than the compact index provides.

200.description: Expanded plain-text export with page summaries and selected body content.

schema.description: Expanded plain-text LLM export generated from the published docs corpus.

fullIndex.value:
# DubStack Docs

## Quickstart
Launch a docs site, connect Git, customize content, and publish.

## Public MCP
DubStack exposes read-only MCP tools so agents can search and inspect published docs.

post.description: Sends a reader question to the public docs assistant for the current site. The assistant answers from published documentation and returns source links when retrieval finds relevant pages. This endpoint is intended for the public reader widget and should be treated as an AI-generated response surface, not a source of dashboard administration state.

value.message: How do I connect a custom domain?

requestBody.description: Reader question and optional current-page context for the public assistant widget.

200.description: Assistant response generated from published documentation, with optional source citations.

value.answer: Open Settings, choose Domain setup, enter your domain, then add the DNS records shown in the dashboard. Once DNS propagates, verify the domain and publish your site.

503.description: Assistant backend is unavailable or disabled for the current site.

get.description: Loads a published OpenAPI specification for the current docs site. Generated API reference pages and the browser request builder use this endpoint to read the same parsed spec metadata, base URL fallback, and operation definitions that were published during the latest sync.

parameters.name: spec
parameters.description: Spec name configured in dubstack.json. Omit this parameter to load the default API reference spec.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Optional preview branch identifier used when rendering branch preview docs.

200.description: Published OpenAPI spec metadata together with the parsed OpenAPI document.

404.description: No published spec exists for the requested site, spec name, or preview branch.

post.description: Proxies a reader-triggered playground request to a target URL allowed by the published OpenAPI spec. The proxy keeps browser playground calls scoped to documented public origins, blocks private or reserved network targets, and avoids placing tenant credentials in frontend code.

requestBody.description: Request generated by the browser playground for a documented operation and allowed target URL.

200.description: Captured upstream response returned to the browser playground.

403.description: Target origin or URL is not allowed by the published OpenAPI spec or playground security policy.

name.description: Human-readable name for the docs MCP server.

description.description: Short description of what the MCP server exposes.
description.example: Read-only MCP server for the published docs site.

transport.description: MCP transport supported by this endpoint.

endpoint.description: Absolute URL clients should use for MCP requests.

capabilities.description: High-level list of public read-only MCP capabilities advertised by this docs site.

tools.description: Tool names available to MCP clients. Public docs tools are read-only and scoped to published documentation.

resources.description: Static resources advertised to MCP clients, such as the generated skill file when enabled.

McpDiscovery.description: Discovery document describing the public read-only MCP server exposed by a published docs site.

name.description: Display name for the public docs MCP server.

description.description: Short explanation of the server purpose.
description.example: Read-only MCP access to the published docs site.

transport.description: Transport protocol used by the MCP endpoint.

McpServerCard.description: Well-known MCP server-card metadata for discovery clients.

id.description: Client-generated request identifier returned in the matching response.

method.description: MCP JSON-RPC method to invoke, such as initialize, tools/list, or tools/call.

params.description: Method-specific parameters. Tool calls include the tool name and an arguments object.

JsonRpcRequest.description: JSON-RPC request envelope used by Streamable HTTP MCP clients.

id.description: Identifier from the request, or null for responses that cannot be matched to a request.

result.description: Successful method result. Shape depends on the MCP method or tool that was called.

error.description: JSON-RPC error object returned when a request cannot be completed.

JsonRpcResponse.description: JSON-RPC response envelope returned by the public MCP server.

message.description: Reader question to answer from the published docs. Use either message or question.

question.description: Alternate reader question field accepted by clients that send question instead of message.

page.description: Optional current docs page path used as local context for the answer.

AssistantRequest.description: Question payload sent by the public reader assistant widget.

example.message: How do I publish a preview deployment?

answer.description: Assistant response text generated from published documentation.

message.description: Alternate response text field returned by compatibility paths.

sources.description: Published docs pages used as supporting context for the answer.

AssistantResponse.description: Answer returned by the public reader assistant widget.

example.answer: Create a branch preview from the dashboard, review the generated URL, then merge or publish when ready.

name.description: Stable spec identifier configured for the docs site.

display_name.description: Human-friendly spec title shown in the dashboard and public docs.

base_url.description: Preferred base URL used by the playground when the OpenAPI document does not define a server URL.

spec_content.description: Parsed OpenAPI document used to render generated endpoint docs and playground controls.

PublishedSpec.description: Wrapper returned by the playground spec loader, including display metadata, base URL fallback, and parsed OpenAPI content.

url.description: Fully resolved URL for the documented operation selected in the playground.

method.description: HTTP method for the documented operation. Defaults to GET when omitted by older clients.

headers.description: Headers supplied by the reader through the playground. Sensitive values should come from user input, not tenant defaults.

body.description: Request body supplied by the playground for methods that support a body.

PlaygroundProxyRequest.description: Browser playground request scoped to a URL allowed by the published OpenAPI spec.

status.description: HTTP status returned by the upstream operation.

headers.description: Response headers returned by the upstream operation after proxy filtering.

body.description: Parsed response body when JSON, otherwise raw response text.

PlaygroundProxyResponse.description: Upstream response captured by the playground proxy and returned to the browser request builder.
